summary: @ornikar/commitlint-config 8.3.12 ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it (execFileSync) against math_init.js — a 727KB heavily-obfuscated JavaScript bundle shipped in the tarball. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-array rotator WV8StW, string-dispatch objects). The advertised purpose of the package is a static commitlint configuration; index.js is an 8-line, 405-byte module.exports of commitlint rules. Fetching a second language runtime at install to execute an opaque obfuscated bundle is unrelated to a commitlint config and is inconsistent with the ornikar/shared-configs repository. The alternate-runtime execution path evades Node-based install-time introspection and grants full code execution on any developer or CI machine that runs `npm install` on this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
